name: platina-reluzente-launcher
description: Biblioteca desktop experimental de portes nativos para Windows e Linux

scripts.check: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/runtime.cjs && node --check electron/black-runtime.cjs && node --check electron/rom-storage.cjs && node --check electron/native-process.cjs && node --check scripts/stage-native-runtime.cjs && node --check scripts/create-data-path-manifest.cjs && node --check web/app.js
scripts.test: npm run check && node --test tests/electron-rom-storage.test.cjs tests/native-process.test.cjs tests/runtime.test.cjs tests/black-runtime.test.cjs tests/stage-native-runtime.test.cjs tests/game-library.test.cjs && npm run build:web
scripts.build:windows: npm run stage:runtime:windows && npm run build:web && electron-builder --win portable --x64
scripts.build:linux: npm run stage:runtime:linux && npm run build:web && electron-builder --linux AppImage tar.gz --x64
